concerns.text: The plan references a sentiment dataset (`snap-cornell/twitter-roberta-base-sentiment-dataset`) that is *not* present in the verified dataset list, and explicitly marks it as missing. FR‑001 requires a verified sentiment source; without a concrete, reachable dataset the requirement cannot be satisfied.

Macro‑economic series are fetched from HuggingFace URLs (`Sonish/gdp-dummy` and `Svetlana0303/FULL_unrated`). These are not the official FRED series required by FR‑002 (GDP and UNRATE via the FRED API). Using inappropriate macro datasets undermines the validity of the economic analysis.

The plan proceeds to downstream modeling steps assuming the sentiment data will be supplied later, but the pipeline will abort if the dataset remains unavailable. This forward‑dependency makes the end‑to‑end analysis infeasible as written.
